desc:
GX Launcher brings your own game collection onto one screen – with a large cover flow inspired by classic console menus.

Choose your game folders and GX Launcher searches all subfolders. Games are recognised by folder name and file content (disc ID, title ID, game code, ROM header) and sorted to the right console.

VIEWS
• Arc, Cover Flow, Grid and List for free; Carousel, Shelf and Channels with Premium
• Home screen with "Continue playing", favourites and console tiles
• Control with mouse, keyboard, touch and gamepad

LIBRARY
• Covers are loaded automatically from public sources (GameTDB, libretro thumbnails) and stored offline
• Region and language with flags, search, sorting, favourites

EXTRAS
• Memory card view for Dolphin with save banners and "Try it"
• Save data overview, cheat lists, play time and statistics
• Emulator selectable per console (e.g. Dolphin, Azahar, melonDS, RetroArch, PPSSPP, PCSX2)

PREMIUM (optional)
All core features are free. Premium (monthly subscription, yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, or lifetime) unlocks all designs, custom colours and effects, extra views, saves and memory cards, cheat menus, statistics and custom covers. Individual design packs are available too. Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime in your Microsoft account.

IMPORTANT
GX Launcher is a launcher. It contains no games, no ROMs, no BIOS and no emulators. Games and emulators required separately. Only use games you legally own.

GX Launcher is an independent project by Flondy Dev. and is not affiliated with Nintendo, Sony or any other manufacturer. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
features: Game collection with a cover flow look
Automatic console detection from your folders
Covers loaded automatically and stored offline
Memory card view for Dolphin with "Try it"
Control with mouse, keyboard and gamepad
short: Your game collection with cover flow, designs and emulator launch in one place.
